card.name: The number right after "every"
card.fires_on: The interval number (or the space just before it) that directly follows "every" in a dosing or monitoring schedule, such as every-3-week, every two weeks, or every 4 weeks.

modes.label: Hyphenated every-N-week
modes.description: A number between hyphens after "every" in a named dosing schedule.
modes.example: First dose of the every-<<3>>-week dosing schedule is given at Week

modes.label: Spaced interval after every
modes.description: The space or spelled-out number after "every" before a unit of weeks or seconds.
modes.example: Administer by subcutaneous injection at Weeks 0, 1, 2, 3, and 4 and every<< >>4 weeks thereafter.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward a time unit such as weeks or months, plus some stray multilingual tokens, so the unit word comes next.
card.plain: It fires on the number after "every" in a schedule, just before the word weeks or months.
